reviews.text: A good vet, who however does not exclude having a trusted clinic on hand, if necessary

For more than 15 years he has been my Toby's doctor, now that I have had another dog for 12 years already, and only to him I turn and he is always friendly and helpful and ready even without an appointment. He has received me in urgent cases if I have to recommend him for care and professionalism, definitely 10,000 times.

Yesterday I went with a puppy that was arriving by courier and since I didn't have a car he was the closest vet and the dog wasn't well he refused to check her saying that I had to make an appointment and that he was full if I had the magic sphere and I knew that the dog was arriving and wasn't well I would have made the appointment unkind person and not humane
Very helpful and knowledgeable. I highly recommend.

Trusted veterinarian for over 20 years. I have 5 dogs and I'm really happy with their professionalism, humanity, and honesty.
I highly recommend them! Never without them!
If I could, I'd give him ten stars for his immense skill, kindness, and professionalism. Highly recommended.
Probably the best vet in the world. Honest, kind, and very knowledgeable. I recommend him to everyone.
Good colleague, very prepared, empathetic

I've known Davide for over fifteen years, and he took it upon himself to support my beloved boxer Baloo's mother and all his siblings. Davide is honest and passionate about his work. He's always provided us with sound advice, as well as providing treatments, checkups, and vaccinations. He's always been available. I can't thank him enough for everything he's done for my beloved boxer Baloo in these 11 years. <3 A heartfelt thank you.

He refused to take care of my cat, telling us that he was fully booked until July (it was June and we showed up without the cat, but with tests to see if we could take him) and to continue with the veterinary clinic they came from and to which we didn't want to return.

Perhaps because the cat has several health conditions?

Of course, it's easier to treat healthy animals...
Dr. Mariani is a truly talented and honest professional, always available, empathetic, and professional.
For 12 years, he's been the only vet in Milan I've turned to for my boxer. He treated her for three different conditions with AMAZING RESULTS thanks to the timely, targeted tests! Highly recommended!

I don't know if I'll ever find another vet like Dr. Mariani. Unfortunately, I have to move, but I can say this about him: he's humane, empathetic, professional, and you can tell he truly loves his job, but above all, he loves animals. A huge thank you, Doctor. For me, it's just goodbye from us. Thank you so much for everything. Ares and Black, and before that, my cat Greta, who is now on the Bridge, are grateful.
Veterinarian recommended
100% recommended, the dermatologist is also very good. Professionalism,
The doctor was truly kind and thorough in his approach and answered every question. As proof, the dog didn't flinch at all during the injection and easily tolerated the uncomfortable maneuvers.
I would say that they are truly two very professional doctors and also very humane and patient. It is clear that they know how to treat our four-legged friends.
Very friendly and helpful. He is our trusted vet for our three furry friends, Molly, Perla, and little Milo.
Very good

Efficiency and kindness! I recommend them to everyone.
